assessments.reasoning: The complete pinned JSON detail records the exact licenseId SWL. Its licenseText matches the publisher's four bounded paragraphs in word order after normalization. [Pinned SPDX detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/SWL.json)

The complete standalone text is filed as text/SWL.txt at the exact pinned commit. All four paragraphs match the publisher's bounded passage in normalized word order. [Pinned SPDX standalone text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/SWL.txt)

The complete UTF-8 HTML range reports the exact publisher capture SHA-256 specified in the claim. The literal bounds from “The authors hereby grant permission” through “ITS TERMS AND CONDITIONS” enclose the grant, disclaimer, government-use provision, and installation acknowledgment. Removing the bare paragraph tags and normalizing whitespace, punctuation, and case yields the same ordered wording as both SPDX representations. [Scheme Widget Library licensing page](https://scheme.com/csv8.3/swl-lic.html)

The complete GitHub tag record identifies annotated tag v3.29.0, object type commit, and target SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. This is the exact commit in both SPDX file URLs. The tag is unsigned. [SPDX release tag object](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

limitations: The finding covers the captured publisher edition and the pinned SPDX documentary representation.
Approval-day copy identity, byte equality, legal equivalence, text reuse, installation, and applicability to any specific work are outside the assessment.
The current effect of the referenced procurement provisions remains unresolved.
reasoning: SPDX 3.29.0 binds to the specified commit, the detail record gives the exact identifier SWL, and both pinned SPDX texts match the bounded publisher wording. The comparison yielded 328 matching whitespace-delimited tokens after punctuation removal. Treating punctuation as a word boundary yields 335 matching word units by splitting NON-INFRINGEMENT, both occurrences of U.S., and the two procurement clause numbers, which adds seven units in each source.
